newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes flat, recovers early loss.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes flat, recovers early loss.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka regained its early loss on year-end supply of the U.S. currency and closed flat at 42.5400/5430 to the dollar, dealers said.
The taka quoted weaker at 42.5420/5460 per dollar but edged up later after foreign and state-owned banks' selling offers.
Early deals were done in the range of 42.5440/5460 but banks eventually offered the dollar at 42.5400, dealers said.

The call money was traded at between 6.75 and 7.25 percent, down from Tuesday's 7.0-7.5 percent. Dealers expect call rates to drop next week following maturity of central bank bills worth about 3.5 billion taka. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
